heading: Evidence and research materials
introduction: Attach an original file to this shared record. Its bytes are encrypted on the host and verified before attachment.
pathHelp: For example, run-37/current-return/capture.img. Include the filename. This records its original location without accessing that path on the host.
selectSame: Select the same original file to resume {name}.
different: The selected file differs from the saved upload. Select the original file; received bytes are retained.
invalidPath: Enter a relative source path ending with the original filename.
paused: Paused. Received chunks are retained on the host. Resume here or reopen this shared record later.
interrupted: The upload could not be confirmed. Refresh unfinished uploads before starting again. {error}
queued: Original received. Verification continues on the host; you may leave this record.
busy: Pause the evidence upload and wait for its current chunk before leaving this record.
